text:
Alex: Heads up — seeing a bunch of GPU jobs failing in eu-west-1, started ~23:10 UTC. Worker pods in gpu-slice namespace can't reach each other (KV sync errors).
Priya: Which namespace exactly? gpu-slice?
Alex: Yep. worker-0 -> worker-1 timeouts, logs: 'dial tcp 10.244.12.8:50051: i/o timeout'. Can still hit redis from the same pod though. :thinking_face:
Marco: Did anyone change NetworkPolicies in that ns recently?
Priya: I just checked audits — security applied a policy 1769129876 about 4m ago to enforce egress controls on gpu-slice. Getting the YAML now.
Priya: ```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: restrict-egress-for-gpu
  namespace: gpu-slice
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      role: worker
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 0.0.0.0/0
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
```
Maria: That ipBlock allow to 0/0 on 443 only — looks like it only allows outbound HTTPS, it doesn't allow pod-to-pod ports (50051). So it effectively blocks internal RPC.
Alex: Aah. But weird that redis (6379) worked — maybe redis is on different host network or uses Service with NodePort?
Marco: The workers talk over direct pod IPs on 50051 (grpc). NetPolicy with only ipBlock to 0/0 + port 443 will block that.
SRE-Bot: incident created: INC-2026-334 (link: https://incidents/redwood/INC-2026-334) — title: gpu-slice interpod connectivity loss.
Priya: Rolling a quick emergency patch to allow intra-namespace egress to pods on 50051 and allow namespaceSelector for same namespace. Applying now.
DeployBot: kube apply --namespace=gpu-slice -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-internal-grpc
  namespace: gpu-slice
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      role: worker
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          k8s-namespace: gpu-slice
      podSelector: {}
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 50051
EOF
DeployBot: applied networkpolicy allow-internal-grpc (sha: a1b2c3)
Alex: After apply, some pods started reconnecting. Errors dropping off.
Maria: We should also update the original restrict-egress rule to include needed cluster ranges or namespaceSelector. I'll open a PR to change ipBlock approach — it's too coarse and blocks east-west RPC.
Marco: Agreed. Suggest policy be explicit: allow namespaceSelector for kube-system, prometheus, and gpu-slice, plus external egress to 0.0.0.0/0:443 if needed.
Priya: Quick mitigation worked. I'm leaving the emergency networkpolicy in place until PR merges. Will follow up with security to coordinate.
Alex: Thanks — this explains failed GPU scheduling and job backpressure. Tagging on call: @Priya @Marco.
Maria: Follow-up action: add a test in our k8s-e2e checks to validate pod-to-pod port traffic in namespaces with NetworkPolicy. Filed: #4321.
SRE-Bot: incident INC-2026-334 updated: mitigated, monitoring.
Alex: Closing thread once PR merged and tests added. :white_check_mark:
